title: Telemetry-driven canary + calibration gating for FP8 on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) profiles on Hopper with an automated, telemetry-driven gating system that protects accuracy SLOs and reduces rollback risk. This ticket scopes the canary design, calibration gating rules, telemetry signals, and runbook for automated rollback/mitigation during progressive rollouts. Deliverables: 1) Canary cohort and rollout policy; 2) Calibration gating rules (per-layer scale sanity checks, cross-batch noise thresholds); 3) Telemetry dashboard and alerting thresholds; 4) CI comparator tests + golden prompt suite integration; 5) Runbook for mitigations and rollback. Context: Prior fp8 calibration tickets focused on calibration pipelines and selector heuristics. This work ties calibration outputs to runtime telemetry and rollout gating so we can safely flip FP8 profiles on for production pools and dedicated clusters without broad regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Canary rollout plan documented with cohort sizes, percent ramp steps, and duration per step
Automated gating evaluates: KL-divergence on generation distributions, token-level perplexity delta, and A/B accuracy delta on golden prompts
Telemetry shows per-layer scale histogram and drift metric for top 10 problematic models
CI comparator job (ci/fp8-golden-compare) passes with <0.5% accuracy delta for core tasks and flags regressions >1%
Automated rollback triggers validated in staging and executed end-to-end using rollback playbook
Post-mortem template created and linked; runbook run-through completed with SOC and on-call
comments: 2026-01-16 — Marco Li: Initial spike completed for telemetry signals. Proved we can compute per-layer scale histograms at ~2ms overhead per request using async sampler. Next: build aggregator to compute KL/divergence and perplexity deltas over rolling windows.
2026-01-20 — Aisha Patel: PM review (Riley Chen) suggested adding a dedicated golden prompt set for enterprise NER and summarization customers — added to Drive folder and CI target.

2026-01-22 — Marco Li: Implemented first-pass gating prototype in canary controller. Gating rules: if KL > 0.02 OR token perplexity delta > 1.03 OR accuracy delta on golden suite > 0.8% -> pause ramp and snapshot calibration artifacts. Unit tests added.
2026-01-25 — Design feedback (Priya Rao): Add UX hooks in Console to surface per-route FP8 status and the last gating decision. Ticket created in product-management to track console work.

2026-01-28 — Marco Li: Ran staged canary against 200k requests across 6 models. Observed a transient rise in token-level variance at step-up for two seq2seq models. Investigation: cross-batch KV cache warmup combined with per-layer scale quantization caused sampling bias. Mitigation: introduce short warmup window (10s) before measurement and use rolling median for per-layer scale estimate. Pushed patch: github PR #1428.

2026-02-02 — QA (Elena Kuznetsova): CI comparator job created (ci/fp8-golden-compare). Failed on one summarization model with 1.2% ROUGE drop. Root cause: outlier activation in layer 9 due to tokenization edge-case. Action: add model-specific calibration override and update tokenizer normalization in runtime. TODO: validate override doesn't mask true regressions.
